opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to register with Mirror Trading International, obtain a Bitcoin wallet, and provide $100 in Bitcoin within seven days. It promotes “a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade” and states that daily trade income is automatically compounded, while describing the full payment as going to a trading account. That combination presents an investment opportunity built around promised income from trading activity, including member allocations and referral-related bonuses. The stated qualifications do not remove the solicitation: trade results are expressly not guaranteed and income depends on positive daily results. The record does not establish whether any funds were processed or whether withdrawals occurred.

citations.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of mirror trading international.
Your daily trade income is automatically compounded.
The trade results are not guaranteed.
